basis: Root supplied motion-reference-repair.json for four native Evidence references, then motion-packaging-repair.json to move two source probe copies into retail-probe/ so they are retained by package rules. Every entry of the final Motion manifest is checked by this study verifier. Product JSON, annotation texts, numeric descriptor fields, API and tests remain the reviewed source hashes. The original independent review is copied byte-for-byte and retains its historical source pins; this addendum and implementation.json carry final pins.
portableCheckerDelta: Copied independent PE metadata checker; removed the old v0.12.11 Source.zip runtime dependency and instead pins the same frozen base SHA256 already compared to that archive in the review. PE parsing, 150 descriptor checks, exact text comparison and numeric field checks are unchanged. Probe.csproj and Program.cs are exact copies of the reviewed compiled probe; run-probe.ps1 keeps build outputs outside this study.
